result.description: Crypto exchange with APIs for spot/futures/margin trading, market data, wallet, earn and account management.
result.auth_detail: Per-account API keys from API Management page. Key sent in X-MBX-APIKEY header; SIGNED endpoints need HMAC-SHA256, RSA or Ed25519 signature. OAuth2 for third-party apps not confirmed in docs read (docs sidebar lists 'Binance OAuth' but unverified).
result.access_detail: Each end user creates own API key in their Binance account; no app review or partner status found for that path. Prereqs: 2FA, identity verification, and a deposit of any amount to Spot account to activate. No fee or paid plan for API found. Deposit/KYC are per-user account requirements, not a vendor review gate. Caveats: regional restrictions (Binance.US separate) not checked; OAuth/Link-style multi-user flows may need partner approval (unverified).
result.api_notes: Product families: Spot, Futures USDⓈ-M and COIN-M, Options, Margin, Wallet, Convert, Portfolio Margin, Algo, Copy Trading, Sub Account, Binance Link, Staking, Simple Earn, C2C, Fiat, Binance Pay. Also WebSocket API/Streams, FIX, SBE.

evidence.quote: We support HMAC, RSA, and Ed25519 keys.
API keys can be created on the API Management page of your Binance account.
Make a deposit of any amount to your Spot Account to activate your account;
Navigate to the relevant product family first, such as Spot, Futures, Wallet, or other supported areas.
Connect your AI agent to Binance with a single URL.
